name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Standardize a single "decision log" template for all departments to record every major choice, with a mandatory one-sentence summary of the trade-off accepted. Engineering owns the template; every other department must use it for their next decision. The trade-off is that teams lose some flexibility in how they document, but we gain a shared language to compare decisions across departments and spot patterns faster.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s template risks turning every decision into a bureaucratic checkbox—slowing teams when speed matters more than record-keeping. Instead, force a *one-sentence* trade-off summary in the *existing* project tracker (e.g., Jira, Notion) with a 5-minute retro after each major choice. Engineering owns the field format; departments just fill it. Settle it by testing both in the next 3 high-risk decisions and measuring time-to-decision vs. clarity.
